text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the appointed candidate are men, so an all-male panel does not indicate sex discrimination against you. While the panel's composition may reflect a broader lack of diversity within the consultancy's leadership, it did not disadvantage you on the basis of sex. 

The decision appears to have hinged on commercial criteria—specifically "excellent client relationships"—rather than purely technical tenure. Raising the panel's gender composition would be unfounded and counterproductive to your professional reputation. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up asking for constructive feedback regarding your interview performance, focusing on how the panel balanced commercial development against major project leadership experience.
